texts.preamble: Rani Kaur vs The State Of Telangana on 10 March, 2022 Author: P.Naveen Rao Bench: P Naveen Rao, G.Radha Rani Hon'Ble Sri Justice P.Naveen Rao And Hon'Ble Smt Dr.JUSTICE G.Radha Rani Writ Petition No.255 of 2022 Date:10.03.2022 Between: Rani Kaur W/o.Karan Singh Aged 21 yrs, R/o.H.No.119-194, Rodamesthri Nagar, Gajularamaram, Jeedimetla, Medchal District, .....Petitioner And The State of Telangana, Rep., by its Principal Secretary to Government, Gad Dept (Spl.Law & Order), Telangana Secretariat, Hyderabad & others. .....Respondents The Court made the following: -2- Hon'Ble Sri Justice P.Naveen Rao And Hon'Ble Smt Dr.JUSTICE G.Radha Rani Writ Petition No.255 of 2022 Order:
texts.facts: The detenu was the Accused No.2 in all the four crimes.
texts.arguments: 2. This writ petition is filed by the wife of detenu- Karan Singh Thilpitya challenging the order of detention dated 26.11.2021 made under Section 3 (2) of the Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits, Drug-Offenders, Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders, Land-Grabbers, Spurious Seed Offenders, Insecticide Offenders, Fertilizer Offenders, Food Adulteration Offenders, Fake Documents Offenders, Scheduled Commodities Offenders, Forest Offenders, Gaming Offenders, Sexual Offenders, Explosive Substances Offenders, Arms Offenders, Cyber Crime offenders and White Collar or Financial Offenders Act, 1986 (Act 1 of 1986). The allegation in all the four crimes relate to theft of construction material. 5. According to learned counsel for the petitioner, the detenu is complying with the conditions imposed in the bail order by appearing before the concerned Station House Officer.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 2. This writ petition is filed by the wife of detenu- Karan Singh Thilpitya challenging the order of detention dated 26.11.2021 made under Section 3 (2) of the Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits, Drug-Offenders, Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders, Land-Grabbers, Spurious Seed Offenders, Insecticide Offenders, Fertilizer Offenders, Food Adulteration Offenders, Fake Documents Offenders, Scheduled Commodities Offenders, Forest Offenders, Gaming Offenders, Sexual Offenders, Explosive Substances Offenders, Arms Offenders, Cyber Crime offenders and White Collar or Financial Offenders Act, 1986 (Act 1 of 1986). The allegation in all the four crimes relate to theft of construction material. 5. According to learned counsel for the petitioner, the detenu is complying with the conditions imposed in the bail order by appearing before the concerned Station House Officer.
